understanding.goal_understanding: The goal in each level was to end with every goal tile marked `+` occupied by a selectable piece at the same time; completing all levels would finish the KA59 run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement was turn-based with a finite step budget, using MOVE_* to shift the currently selected piece one tile unless blocked by walls/obstacles or other immovable objects; CLICK on a piece’s coordinates was used to select/switch which piece to control (and in some cases attempted to interact/move but would do nothing if the target was blocked or not a valid selectable/interaction).
